/* File.selectFileDgnssFileList */ SELECT a1.`id` AS fileIdx , a1.file_name AS fileName , a1.save_file_name AS saveFileName , a1.file_path AS filePath , a1.file_extension AS fileExtension , a1.file_size AS fileSize , a1.rgtr , a1.reg_dt AS regDt , a1.request_source AS requestSource , a1.checksum AS checksum , a1.del_yn AS delYn , a1.prsinfo_yn AS prsInfoYn , tdri.stdt_id AS userId , gm_st.user_no AS userNo , u_st.sp_user_id AS userSpUserId , tdri.stdt_id AS userNm , tdri.file_url AS fileUrl , tdi.paper_idx AS paperIdx , tdi.ord_no AS ordNo
, CASE /* 요청자가 해당 검사 클래스의 교사인 경우 - 전체 허용 */ WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_info gi_req WHERE gi_req.cla_id = tdi.cla_id AND gi_req.host_user_no = #{reqUserNo} ) /* 요청자가 해당 검사의 학생이고 본인 리포트인 경우 */ OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_info gi_req_st INNER JOIN group_member gm_req_st ON gi_req_st.group_id = gm_req_st.group_id WHERE gi_req_st.cla_id = tdi.cla_id AND gm_req_st.user_no = #{reqUserNo} AND gm_req_st.stdt_id = tdri.stdt_id ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END downloadAuthYn
, 'Y' AS downloadAuthYn
FROM file a1 INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri ON a1.file_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX(tdri.file_url, '/', -1) AND a1.file_path = CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tdri.file_url, '/', LENGTH(tdri.file_url) - LENGTH(REPLACE(tdri.file_url, '/', ''))), '/') AND tdri.file_url IS NOT NULL AND tdri.file_url != '' INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_info tdi ON tdri.dgnss_id = tdi.id LEFT JOIN group_info gi ON tdi.cla_id = gi.cla_id LEFT JOIN group_member gm_st ON gi.group_id = gm_st.group_id AND gm_st.stdt_id = tdri.stdt_id LEFT JOIN user u_st ON u_st.user_no = gm_st.user_no WHERE tdi.id = #{dgnssId} AND a1.file_extension = 'pdf'
SELECT af.id AS fileIdx , CONCAT(af.file_path, af.save_file_name) AS filePath FROM file af WHERE af.prsinfo_yn = 'Y' AND af.del_yn = 'N'

/* FileMapper.selectTcDgnssInfoWithId */ SELECT tdi.cla_id AS claId , tdi.paper_idx AS paperIdx , tdi.ord_no AS ordNo , tdi.tc_id AS tcId , gi.group_nm AS claNm FROM tb_dgnss_info tdi LEFT JOIN group_info gi ON tdi.cla_id = gi.cla_id LEFT JOIN USER u ON tdi.tc_id = u.user_no WHERE tdi.id = #{dgnssId}

/* File.selectFileDgnssSummaryList */ SELECT a1.`id` as fileIdx , a1.file_name as fileName , a1.save_file_name as saveFileName , a1.file_path as filePath , a1.file_extension as fileExtension , a1.file_size as fileSize , a1.rgtr , a1.reg_dt as regDt , a1.request_source as requestSource , a1.checksum as checksum , a1.del_yn as delYn , a1.prsinfo_yn as prsInfoYn , tdri.stdt_id AS userId , gm_st.user_no AS userNo , u_st.sp_user_id AS userSpUserId , tdri.stdt_id AS userNm , tdri.summary_file_url AS fileUrl , tdi.paper_idx AS paperIdx , tdi.ord_no AS ordNo
, CASE /* 요청자가 해당 검사 클래스의 교사인 경우 - 전체 허용 */ WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_info gi_req WHERE gi_req.cla_id = tdi.cla_id AND gi_req.host_user_no = #{reqUserNo} ) /* 요청자가 해당 검사의 학생이고 본인 리포트인 경우 */ OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_info gi_req_st INNER JOIN group_member gm_req_st ON gi_req_st.group_id = gm_req_st.group_id WHERE gi_req_st.cla_id = tdi.cla_id AND gm_req_st.user_no = #{reqUserNo} AND gm_req_st.stdt_id = tdri.stdt_id ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END downloadAuthYn
, 'Y' AS downloadAuthYn
FROM file a1 INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri ON a1.file_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX(tdri.summary_file_url, '/', -1) AND a1.file_path = CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tdri.summary_file_url, '/', LENGTH(tdri.summary_file_url) - LENGTH(REPLACE(tdri.summary_file_url, '/', ''))), '/') AND tdri.summary_file_url IS NOT NULL AND tdri.summary_file_url != '' INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_info tdi ON tdri.dgnss_id = tdi.id LEFT JOIN group_info gi ON tdi.cla_id = gi.cla_id LEFT JOIN group_member gm_st ON gi.group_id = gm_st.group_id AND gm_st.stdt_id = tdri.stdt_id LEFT JOIN user u_st ON u_st.user_no = gm_st.user_no WHERE tdi.id = #{dgnssId} AND a1.file_extension = 'pdf'
